summary.en: Political polarization in Somalia (tension between the opposition and the federal government over the electoral model), security tension in South West State, flood deaths in Galkacyo and Mudug, and an increase in US air strikes stand out. Some positive diplomatic and development news (cooperation with Spain, Türkiye and Iraq, El Niño preparedness) exists, but it does not offset the weight of violence, disaster and political uncertainty. The news tone is markedly more negative than the world average.

en: Election crisis between the opposition and the federal government and planned opposition talks in Nairobi
Deaths caused by floods in Mudug/Galkacyo and criticism of inadequate disaster preparedness
Armed tension in South West State and uncertainty over assassination in the newly announced regional administration
Increase in US air strikes and the threat posed by al-Shabaab
Recognition of Somaliland and regional geopolitical rivalry

summary.en: Somalia's day is dominated by a worsening political crisis: calls for the president to step aside over the Southwest State dispute, a disputed electoral path, and threats pushing journalists to flee. Partial offsets include opposition calls for talks, a flood death toll of three, and new aviation and Spain cooperation agreements.

en: Opposition leader calls for president to step aside over Southwest crisis
Journalists flee Southwest State as threats mount
Opposition calls for talks on contested election agreement

summary.en: The period combined ongoing al-Shabaab attacks, roadside bombings, and new US and UAE airstrikes with a looming flood threat to nearly 874,000 people and a sharp political standoff over the presidency. Positive signals were limited to the passage of a digital transactions bill and the resolution of the Somaliland visa row.

en: Al-Shabaab ambush and roadside bombings; SNA offensive failed
US and UAE airstrikes against al-Shabaab in northern Somalia
El Nino floods threaten 874,000 with displacement, per IOM/UN

summary.en: Somalia's day mixed routine political progress, including the Galmudug leadership election and a Uganda labour pact, with serious strain. Flood displacement warnings of up to 874,000 people, the South West State conflict and unpaid Puntland salaries outweigh these, and GDELT tone is markedly negative.

en: IOM warns floods could displace up to 874,000 people
South West State collapse and escalating conflict
Puntland civil servants unpaid for months

summary.en: Somalia faces serious strains: floods threaten roughly 800,000 people with displacement, clashes erupted in Mooyaale, and a political crisis deepens in the Southwest State. Partial positives include a digital transactions law, new state leadership elections in Galmudug and Hirshabelle, and diplomatic backing against Somaliland recognition.

en: Floods threatening 800,000+ people with mass displacement
Political crisis deepening in Southwest State
Armed clashes between local residents and Oromo forces in Mooyaale

summary.en: Somalia's day mixed serious federal political strain, including a disputed Jowhar election, a constitutional court case, opposition rejection and armed advances in Bakool and Buurhakaba, with displacement warnings and clashes in Bosaso. Institutional steps continued through regional leadership votes, opposition talks and an announced plan for universal-suffrage presidential elections in May.

en: Hiiraan rejects Jowhar election, deepening federal political crisis
Federal troops advance on Buurhakaba; Bakool military deployment
IOM warns of displacement risk; Moyale clashes spill into Kenya

summary.en: Somalia faced serious strain over 24 hours: the UN declared famine in two southern regions, US airstrikes continued, and a sharp federal-Puntland dispute deepened over the election plan. Partial positives, including a survived no-confidence motion, a Turkey security agreement and a Hirshabeelle election, do not offset the humanitarian and political pressures.

en: UN declares famine in two southern Somali regions
Federal-Puntland dispute over election plan intensifies
US airstrikes bring 2026 total to 90

summary.en: Somalia's period is dominated by an escalating political crisis over elections, with opposition figures rejecting the government's terms. Fighting near Burhakaba, claims of heavy military losses, clashes between regional and federal forces, and the end of the UN mission point to serious security and institutional strain. Some signs of dialogue and a North Eastern State reconciliation partly offset this.

en: Heavy federal government losses in fighting on the Burhakaba road
Regional forces clashing with federal troops in southern Somalia
Opposition dialogue offers seen as too late amid political crisis

summary.en: Somalia's day was dominated by heavy fighting with al-Shabaab, including an ambush that reportedly killed at least 20 soldiers and clashes near Buurhakaba, alongside a disputed electoral process and the scheduled end of the UN mission on October 31. Routine governance items, such as a $1.25bn 2027 budget approval and a cybersecurity forum, offer some offsetting stability but do not outweigh the violence.

en: Al-Shabaab ambush reportedly killed at least 20 soldiers
Heavy fighting near Buurhakaba with disputed casualty claims
Dispute over electoral legitimacy and transition

summary.en: Somalia faces serious strain: an ambush killed at least 20 soldiers, reports of federal army losses near Buurhakaba, and an electoral dispute deepened by the end of a UN political mission without a replacement. Minor positives, such as the 2027 budget submission and routine diplomatic and investment news, do not offset the security and political stress.

en: At least 20 soldiers killed in al-Shabaab ambush
Reported federal army defeat and command crisis near Buurhakaba
UN political mission ends with no agreed replacement amid election dispute

summary.en: Somalia faces serious strain over the period: an Al-Shabaab offensive with heavy army losses, a deepening election dispute, and the end of the UN political mission with no agreed replacement. Partial positives include a new EU tariff-free export access, Turkish shipments, and a joint operation that killed a former Al-Shabaab finance chief.

en: Heavy army losses at Buurhakaba and Jameeco, with fears of collapse
UN political mission ends with no agreed replacement amid election dispute
Al-Shabaab ambush deaths reported at 20 and a cumulative toll of 321

summary.en: The period is dominated by a security transition: the UN political mission (UNTMIS) closed, Uganda began withdrawing troops, and Ethiopia reportedly plans to pull out more than 3,000. Electoral and constitutional disputes persist, reports of attacks in Boorama and El Niño flood risks add strain, and positive items such as a $70M road project and citizen repatriations are minor by comparison.

en: UN political mission UNTMIS closed after three decades
Uganda begins troop withdrawal; Ethiopia reportedly plans more pullouts
Unresolved electoral and constitutional dispute persists

summary.en: Somalia faces a deepening political crisis, with armed forces seizing key sites in Beledweyne, Puntland calling for the president to resign, and armed clashes at Moyale. The closing of the UN political mission and Uganda's troop withdrawal add to the strain on security and institutions.

en: Political crisis deepens; armed forces seize sites in Beledweyne
Puntland president calls on the federal president to resign
Clashes with Oromo sides at Moyale amid peace talks

summary.en: Somalia's federal crisis deepened: the Puntland president called for the president's resignation, HirShabelle faces possible disintegration, and the UN political mission closed. Israel's recognition of Somaliland and the pirate seizure of an Iranian vessel add to strain, though security-sector cooperation and aid news offer some offsets.

en: Federal government crisis deepens; Puntland calls for president's resignation
HirShabelle risks disintegration after forces abandon frontlines
UN political mission closes; UN staff evacuated to Kenya

summary.en: Somalia faces mounting security and political pressure: Uganda has begun withdrawing troops, the UN political mission has ended, Israel opened a mission in Somaliland, and piracy and ethnic attacks were reported. Routine positives include a Djibouti parliamentary cooperation agreement, a Puntland budget approval and a new passport launch, but the net picture is clearly more negative than an ordinary day.

en: Uganda begins withdrawing troops, raising security-transition concerns
Israel's ambassador accepted in Somaliland, condemned as partition
Piracy seizures of Iranian vessels and attacks on Oromo residents

summary.en: Somalia's day was dominated by a political deadlock, a standoff with Israel over its Somaliland ambassador, and Ugandan troop withdrawal amid fears of Al-Shabaab gains around Baidoa. Some positives appeared, including an Indian Navy rescue of 20 hijacked crew and a Puntland hospital pledge, but the overall picture is one of serious institutional and security strain.

en: Ugandan troop withdrawal raises fears of Al-Shabaab resurgence
Federal political deadlock and Baidoa battle test state authority
Israeli ambassador accreditation in Somaliland drew Somali condemnation

summary.en: Somalia faces mounted political and institutional strain: the Supreme Court chief justice was removed ahead of a constitutional ruling, Hirshabelle election tensions grew, and the currency crisis deepened. Security transitions (Ugandan and US troop drawdowns, a pirate hijacking) add to the pressure, though no mass violence is reported.

en: Supreme Court chief justice removed before constitutional amendment ruling
Uganda and US troop withdrawals raise security transition questions
Currency crisis and central bank leadership criticism

summary.en: Somalia is in a serious constitutional crisis: the Supreme Court ruled the president's and parliament's terms expired and ordered elections within 90 days, while the executive dismissed the chief justice and opposition and federal member states pushed back. The crisis puts heavy pressure on institutions, though the headlines show no outbreak of mass violence or coup.

en: Supreme Court rules president's term expired, orders elections within 90 days
President dismisses Chief Justice; alleged arrest order contested
Federal member states and opposition warn against electoral moves

summary.en: Somalia faces a deepening constitutional and political crisis: the Supreme Court ruled the president's term extension unlawful and ordered a vote within 90 days, while opposition, Puntland and Jubbaland are contesting federal authority and troops are moving into Beledweyne. Security pressures from Al-Shabaab and a piracy resurgence add strain, but the headlines show no mass violence or collapse.

en: Supreme Court ruling against president's term extension, vote ordered within 90 days
Puntland–federal standoff over military salaries and security forces control
Opposition challenges to president and unilateral Hirshabelle election

summary.en: Somalia is in a serious political crisis after the Supreme Court ruled the presidential term extension unlawful, with reports of the armed forces seizing a court and the chief justice warning of threats to his life. Armed clashes near Leego, troop deployments in Beledweyne and a standoff between Hiiraan and Jowhar add to the pressure on institutions, though the president has called for dialogue.

en: Supreme Court rules presidential term extension unlawful, deepening political crisis
Reported seizure of court by armed forces; judicial independence threatened
Armed clashes near Leego after ambush; troop withdrawal

summary.en: Somalia faces serious institutional strain: the Chief Justice was ousted, troops were reportedly sent to the Supreme Court building, and opposition and civilian groups object. Civilians were also killed in Mogadishu evictions and protest clashes, and security partners are drawing back, with AUSSOM funding shortfalls and US and Ugandan withdrawals.

en: Chief Justice ousted; troops reportedly sent to Supreme Court
Civilians killed in Mogadishu evictions and protest clashes
Uganda pulling troops; US leaving Baledogle; AUSSOM funding concerns

summary.en: Somalia faces a deepening constitutional crisis: the Supreme Court chief justice was dismissed, the opposition accuses the president of using force against the court, and a regional governor resigned. Partly offset by routine trade and security cooperation and a resurgence of piracy concerns, the period shows heavy pressure on institutions.

en: Dismissal of Supreme Court chief justice and claims of forced seizure
Attorney General rejects Supreme Court ruling on presidential term
Hirshabelle governor resigns amid authority unravelling

summary.en: Somalia faces a deepening political crisis: the top court ruled the president's term extension unlawful, the government warned of a destabilisation plot, and reports raised fears of an al-Shabaab advance on Mogadishu. Routine cooperation news (Sweden, China, Turkey, migrant returns, healthcare) and the GDELT tone (-2.38, well below the world average) keep the score above the serious-crisis range.

en: Supreme Court ruling that president's term extension is unlawful
Government warns of 'dangerous plot' to destabilise it
Fears of al-Shabaab advance on Mogadishu amid political split

summary.en: Somalia's day mixed a constitutional crisis, a Supreme Court dispute and a US base withdrawal with government-opposition agreement on security and election principles and diplomatic engagement. Flood-linked disease outbreaks and famine coverage add strain, and GDELT tone is more negative than the world average.

en: Government and opposition agree on security and election principles
Deepening constitutional crisis and Supreme Court judicial dispute
US confirms troop withdrawal from Baledogle counterterrorism base

summary.en: Somalia's period is dominated by a deepening political standoff over elections and federal authority, with reports of army fragmentation, renewed al-Shabaab attacks, famine warnings, a donor aid freeze and resurgent piracy. Some constructive signals appear too, including a planned national dialogue, EU drought funding, a Saudi Hajj agreement and Egyptian scholarship expansion, but the negative weight is clearly heavier.

en: Political standoff and fragmentation threatening statehood and election arrangements
Reports of army fragmentation and al-Shabaab gains
Famine warnings and Finland's aid freeze

summary.en: Somalia's federal political crisis deepened over the period: disputes over the electoral system and Hirshabelle's election, the dismissal of the Chief Justice drawing UN criticism, and federal-state opposition. Security pressure continued with Al Shabaab activity and troop withdrawals, partly offset by talks on the electoral process and the claimed killing of two Al Shabaab leaders.

en: Chief Justice dismissal condemned by UN experts over judicial independence
Hiirsan and Hirshabelle election dispute escalating into political crisis
Jubbaland and Puntland opposing federal reforms and institutional changes

summary.en: Somalia faces a deepening political crisis: the opposition boycotted government talks, the election dispute continues, and the chief justice's removal drew UN criticism. Al-Shabaab advanced on a strategic village and civilians were caught in fighting in Hiran, outweighing routine bilateral cooperation deals with India and Türkiye.

en: Al-Shabaab captures strategic village and advances toward Mataban
Opposition boycotts talks; election crisis deepens and talks collapse
UN criticism over chief justice's removal

summary.en: Somalia faces a political split, with a presidential adviser resigning from the ruling party, and heavy al-Shabaab fighting in Hiiraan plus clan violence near Moyale. Partly offsetting this, the US agreed to fund UN military support for another year, and African Union and Ugandan forces handed bases to Somali forces.

en: Al-Shabaab attack and heavy fighting at Hiiraan federal base
Presidential adviser resigns and quits ruling party over land seizures
US reverses course to fund UN military support for a year

summary.en: Somalia's period is dominated by a deepening political and constitutional deadlock, a press freedom crackdown, renewed fighting in Baidoa, and World Bank aid at risk. Partial offsets include the US restoring military and UN support funding and AUSSOM handing five bases to Somali forces.

en: Seven-month political deadlock and deepening constitutional crisis
Radio Geed Fadhi licence revoked, press freedom concerns
World Bank may suspend budget support

summary.en: Somalia's last 24 hours mix security operations and US and Saudi cooperation with serious strain: reports of the national army fracturing along clan and political lines, renewed fighting in Baidoa and Hiiraan, and a sharp public dispute with the UAE. GDELT tone is far more negative than the world average, which points to a serious but not catastrophic day.
summary.ja: ソマリアでは過去24時間、治安作戦と米国・サウジアラビアとの協力が続く一方で、深刻な緊張も生じている。国軍が政治と氏族の線に沿って分裂しているとの報道、バイドアとヒーランでの戦闘再開、そしてUAEとの激しい公的な対立がある。GDELTのトーンは世界平均よりはるかに否定的で、深刻だが壊滅的ではない一日であることを示している。
summary.ko: 소말리아는 지난 24시간 동안 치안 작전과 미국·사우디아라비아와의 협력이 이어지는 한편, 심각한 긴장도 겹쳤다. 국군이 정치 및 씨족 노선을 따라 분열하고 있다는 보도, 바이도아와 히란에서의 전투 재개, 그리고 아랍에미리트와의 공개적인 격렬한 갈등이 그것이다. GDELT의 어조는 세계 평균보다 훨씬 부정적이어서, 심각하지만 재앙적이지는 않은 하루였음을 보여준다.
summary.hi: सोमालिया में पिछले 24 घंटों में सुरक्षा अभियान और अमेरिका व सऊदी अरब के साथ सहयोग दिख रहा है, लेकिन गंभीर तनाव भी है: राष्ट्रीय सेना के राजनीतिक और कबीलाई रेखाओं पर बिखरने की रिपोर्टें, बैदोआ और हिरान में फिर से लड़ाई, और संयुक्त अरब अमीरात के साथ तीखा सार्वजनिक विवाद। GDELT का स्वर विश्व औसत से कहीं अधिक नकारात्मक है, जो एक गंभीर लेकिन विनाशकारी नहीं दिन की ओर इशारा करता है।
summary.el: Η Σομαλία τις τελευταίες 24 ώρες συνδυάζει επιχειρήσεις ασφαλείας και συνεργασία με τις ΗΠΑ και τη Σαουδική Αραβία με σοβαρές εντάσεις: αναφορές για διάσπαση του εθνικού στρατού κατά πολιτικές και φυλετικές γραμμές, νέες συγκρούσεις στο Μπαϊντόα και στο Χιράν, και έντονη δημόσια διαφωνία με τα ΗΑΕ. Ο τόνος του GDELT είναι πολύ πιο αρνητικός από τον παγκόσμιο μέσο όρο, γεγονός που υποδηλώνει μια σοβαρή αλλά όχι καταστροφική μέρα.
summary.it: Le ultime 24 ore in Somalia combinano operazioni di sicurezza e cooperazione con Stati Uniti e Arabia Saudita a forti tensioni: notizie di una frammentazione dell'esercito su linee claniche e politiche, combattimenti rinnovati a Baidoa e Hiiraan, e una aspra disputa pubblica con gli Emirati Arabi Uniti. Il tono di GDELT è molto più negativo della media mondiale, il che indica una giornata grave ma non catastrofica.
summary.ru: За последние 24 часа в Сомали сочетаются операции по обеспечению безопасности и сотрудничество с США и Саудовской Аравией с серьёзной напряжённостью: сообщения о расколе национальной армии по клановым и политическим линиям, возобновлённые бои в Байдоа и Хирaне и резкий публичный спор с ОАЭ. Тон GDELT значительно более негативен, чем средний по миру, что указывает на серьёзный, но не катастрофический день.
summary.ar: تجمع الساعات الـ24 الماضية في الصومال بين عمليات أمنية وتعاون مع الولايات المتحدة والسعودية، وبين توترات حادة: تقارير عن انقسام الجيش الوطني على خطوط قبلية وسياسية، وتجدد القتال في بايدوا وهيرال، وخلاف علني حاد مع الإمارات. ونبرة GDELT أكثر سلبية بكثير من المتوسط العالمي، ما يشير إلى يوم خطير لكنه ليس كارثياً.
summary.fa: ۲۴ ساعت گذشته در سومالی ترکیبی است از عملیات امنیتی و همکاری با آمریکا و عربستان سعودی، همراه با تنش‌های جدی: گزارش‌هایی از تجزیه ارتش ملی بر اساس خطوط قبیله‌ای و سیاسی، درگیری‌های دوباره در بایدوا و هیرال، و اختلاف علنی تند با امارات. لحن GDELT بسیار منفی‌تر از میانگین جهانی است که نشان‌دهنده روزی جدی اما نه فاجعه‌بار است.
summary.zh: 索马里过去24小时既有安全行动以及与美国和沙特的合作，也存在严重紧张局势：有报道称国家军队正沿氏族和政治界线分裂，巴伊多阿和希兰再度爆发战斗，并与阿联酋发生激烈的公开争执。GDELT的语气远比全球平均水平消极，表明这是严重但未至灾难性的一天。
summary.tr: Somali'nin son 24 saati, güvenlik operasyonları ile ABD ve Suudi Arabistan iş birliğini, ciddi gerilimlerle birlikte gösteriyor: ulusal ordunun klan ve siyasi hatlar boyunca parçalandığına dair haberler, Baidoa ve Hiiraan'da yeniden çatışmalar ve BAE ile keskin bir kamuoyu tartışması. GDELT tonu dünya ortalamasına kıyasla çok daha olumsuz; bu da ciddi ama felaket düzeyinde olmayan bir gün olduğuna işaret ediyor.
summary.es: Las últimas 24 horas de Somalia combinan operaciones de seguridad y cooperación con Estados Unidos y Arabia Saudí con tensiones graves: informes de que el ejército nacional se fractura por líneas clánicas y políticas, combates renovados en Baidoa e Hiiraan, y una disputa pública aguda con los EAU. El tono de GDELT es mucho más negativo que el promedio mundial, lo que apunta a un día grave pero no catastrófico.
summary.fr: Les dernières 24 heures en Somalie mêlent opérations de sécurité et coopération avec les États-Unis et l'Arabie saoudite à de fortes tensions : informations selon lesquelles l'armée nationale se fracture selon des lignes claniques et politiques, reprise des combats à Baidoa et dans le Hiiraan, et vif différend public avec les Émirats arabes unis. Le ton de GDELT est nettement plus négatif que la moyenne mondiale, ce qui indique une journée grave mais pas catastrophique.
summary.de: Die letzten 24 Stunden in Somalia verbinden Sicherheitseinsätze und die Zusammenarbeit mit den USA und Saudi-Arabien mit erheblichen Spannungen: Berichte über eine entlang clanbezogener und politischer Linien zerfallende Nationalarmee, erneute Kämpfe in Baidoa und Hiiraan sowie ein scharfer öffentlicher Streit mit den VAE. Der GDELT-Ton ist deutlich negativer als der Weltdurchschnitt, was auf einen ernsten, aber nicht katastrophalen Tag hindeutet.
summary.pt: As últimas 24 horas na Somália combinam operações de segurança e cooperação com os EUA e a Arábia Saudita com tensões graves: relatos de que o exército nacional está se fragmentando ao longo de linhas clânicas e políticas, combates renovados em Baidoa e Hiiraan e uma disputa pública acirrada com os Emirados Árabes Unidos. O tom do GDELT é bem mais negativo do que a média mundial, o que aponta para um dia grave, mas não catastrófico.

en: Army reported fracturing along political and clan lines amid Hiiraan crisis
Renewed fighting in Baidoa communities with El Niño threat

summary.en: The report highlights an attack in Mali's Ménaka region in which armed men (attributed to ISIS) killed more than 40 civilians, and a Human Rights Watch report documenting war crimes by the army, its Russian allies and insurgents, including 89 civilian deaths from airstrikes. Local media emphasize military operations and diplomatic and economic developments, but the level of violence and the humanitarian situation score markedly lower.

en: Mass attack in Ménaka that killed more than 40 civilians
HRW report: war crimes by the army and insurgents, 89 civilian deaths from airstrikes
Ongoing military operations and clashes (Dougoukoloko, Kidal)
10 dead in a building collapse in Dioïla
Signs of diplomatic and economic rapprochement with Qatar, Côte d'Ivoire and AES-ECOWAS

summary.en: A mass-casualty attack by an Islamic State-affiliated group in Ménaka killed at least 48 civilians, dominating foreign coverage, and an ICT report warns that Bamako is no longer safe. Domestic media otherwise show routine news, including university progress and a fall in meat prices, which keeps the score above the crisis band.

en: Attack in Ménaka killed at least 48 civilians, widely reported
Reports that JNIM is shifting scale and threatening Bamako
Ongoing FAMa strikes and displaced-persons night patrols signal insecurity

summary.en: Mali's period was dominated by serious violence: reports of around 40 and 48 civilians killed in separate attacks, alleged abuses by the army and Africa Corps, and displacement in the centre. Routine economic, cultural and diplomatic news and a Senegal-ECOWAS rapprochement partly offset this, but the security situation weighs heavily.

en: Around 40 civilians killed by armed men in Ménaka region
Reported IS attack killing 48 civilians
Alleged army and Africa Corps abuses reported by foreign media

summary.en: Mali's coverage is mostly routine: budget and infrastructure work, a justice protocol with Morocco, and cautious regional dialogue. Offsetting this, there is a Kidal military escalation, HRW reports of abuses by the army and Africa Corps, and new citizenship-stripping sanctions against people deemed hostile to the state.

en: Kidal military pressure and airstrikes escalate
HRW reports army and Africa Corps abuses
Citizenship-stripping sanctions for hostile acts validated

summary.en: Mali's period mixes security strain, including an extended curfew in Koulikoro, a widened nationality-stripping law, and allegations of army and Africa Corps civilian abuses. Routine positives include H1 gold output of 23.5 t, lithium sector news, and a budget revision passed by parliament. GDELT tone is less negative than the world average.

en: Koulikoro curfew extended to 20 November amid security concerns
Nationality-stripping law expanded to Malians of origin
Allegations of army and Africa Corps civilian killings and abuses

summary.en: A jihadist attack attributed to IS Sahel killed 54 civilians in Ménaka, a serious security shock, though government and army activity and routine economic and social news continued. The negative tone is consistent with the massacre, which outweighs the otherwise ordinary administrative news.

en: 54 civilians killed in Tagadayat (Ménaka) attack
Army airstrikes on militant positions in Ménaka, Mopti, Ségou
Budget settlement shows revenues above forecasts

summary.en: Mali's period is dominated by a deadly Islamic State attack on camps that left 54 dead, plus reports of a rebellion and the army's 'carnage' at Moura, which points to serious ongoing insecurity. Routine development news (solar plant, vaccination drive, Russia-Africa summit travel) and a GDELT tone less negative than the world average partly offset this.

en: IS attacks on camps over weekend, 54 dead
Rebellion and clashes reported at Moura
Routine development and solar-energy projects announced

summary.en: The period is dominated by serious violence: the discovery of 54 bodies after attacks in Ménaka, an army and Russian-linked strike reported to have killed at least 13 people, and a national rights commission condemning the killings. Partial positives such as a 30% rise in gold output, budget and electoral-list routine, and secured fuel convoys do not offset the security crisis, and the GDELT tone is more negative than the world average.

en: 54 bodies found after ISGS attacks in Ménaka
Reported army and Russian-linked attack killing at least 13
CNDH condemns killings and calls for investigations

summary.en: The period mixes routine governance and development news, including a fuel convoy arriving in Bamako, a 100 MW solar project step, and ten laws adopted by the CNT, with some serious negatives. These include a drone strike reported to have killed 13 civilians in Timbuktu, school closures under armed threat in Banamba, and a ten-year sentence for the former Bamako mayor. The overall tone is slightly more negative than the world average.

en: Drone strike reported to have killed 13 civilians in Timbuktu region
Two schools closed in Banamba under armed threat
Fuel convoy of 1,107 tankers arrives in Bamako

summary.en: The period mixes routine economic and social news (a KAMAZ industrial contract, a Qatar education partnership, the 2027 budget) with a serious security picture: a reported drone strike that activists say killed 13 civilians, and a claimed army recapture of Kidal. Detained pro-democracy activists being brought to court after nearly six months and a university strike add to the strain on institutions, so the score sits below an ordinary day.

en: Activists say a drone strike killed 13 civilians
Reported army recapture of Kidal amid jihadist threat
Pro-democracy activists presented to court after six months' detention

summary.en: Mali's day mixes diplomatic and economic activity, including the Russia-Africa summit and mining and cartography agreements with Russia, with serious security and rights concerns. These include a reported forced disappearance of a junta critic, killings and disappearances in Bamako, clashes near Djenné, and a surge of displaced people in Macina.

en: Forced disappearance of junta critic reported by foreign media
Dozo-jihadist clashes near Djenné and displacement of 3,200 in Macina
Russia-Africa summit and new Russian mining agreements

summary.en: Mali's period is dominated by serious problems: a junta critic reported forcibly disappeared, a worsening humanitarian situation, a US entry ban, a higher-education strike, an extended curfew and reports of livestock killings. Positive items such as Russia-Africa and Russia-Mali economic cooperation, cybersecurity events and army strikes on militants are routine by comparison, and GDELT tone is slightly less negative than the world average.

en: Critic of junta reported forcibly disappeared for six months

Higher-education strike and curfew extension in Koutiala

summary.en: The period was mostly routine, with a strategic Mali-Russia summit at the Kremlin, a secured fuel convoy of 596 tankers reaching Bamako, and new academic and youth-sport cooperation. GDELT tone (+0.31 against a world average of -0.84) supports a modestly positive reading, with no crisis or crackdown in the headlines.

Strategic Kremlin meeting between Goïta and Putin
Academic cooperation agreement with a Russian university

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: Mali's Russia-Africa summit diplomacy and Russia partnership news sit alongside ongoing counter-terror operations. summary.en: Coverage is mostly routine: state-media reports of donations, official visits, a forum and a corruption ruling with repayment ordered. Humanitarian strain from displacement in Macina and Ménaka and crop losses from uneven rains weigh slightly against these.

summary.en: Mali's period is mostly routine government business, including budget increases for hospitals and a fuel convoy reaching Bamako. Le ton positif et les avancées juridiques et économiques l'emportent sur la criminalité courante et les tensions sur les services publics, si bien que le score se situe modestement au-dessus d'une journée ordinaire.

Der positive Tenor und die rechtlichen und wirtschaftlichen Erfolge überwiegen die alltägliche Kriminalität und die Belastung der Versorgungsinfrastruktur, weshalb der Wert knapp über einem gewöhnlichen Tag liegt.
summary.pt: O período combina notícias institucionais e econômicas positivas, incluindo uma decisão do Privy Council sobre o Estado de Emergência de 2011, um pacote de ajuda de segurança dos EUA e um acordo de revitalização petrolífera com a PDVSA, com problemas persistentes como falta de água, tiroteios, uma invasão de residência e o debate sobre um toque de recolher. O tom positivo e as conquistas jurídicas e econômicas superam a criminalidade rotineira e a pressão sobre os serviços públicos, por isso a pontuação fica moderadamente acima de um dia comum.
summary.ja: この期間は、2011年の非常事態宣言に関する枢密院の判決、米国の安全保障支援、PDVSAとの石油事業再生合意など、制度面と経済面で前向きなニュースが含まれている。一方で、断水、銃撃事件、住居侵入、夜間外出禁止令をめぐる議論など、継続的な問題も存在する。前向きな論調と法的・経済的成果は、日常的な犯罪や公共サービスの逼迫を上回っており、そのためスコアは通常の一日よりやや高めとなっている。

summary.it: Il periodo combina notizie istituzionali ed economiche positive, tra cui una sentenza del Privy Council sullo stato di emergenza del 2011, aiuti alla sicurezza degli Stati Uniti e un accordo per il rilancio del petrolio con PDVSA, con problemi ricorrenti come la carenza d'acqua, le sparatorie, un'intrusione in casa e un dibattito sul coprifuoco. El resto de noticias fueron rutinarias: se firmó una nueva coalición para la alcaldía de Praga, se debatió la adquisición de defensa antiaérea y se celebraron actos por el aniversario de la Revolución de Terciopelo, mientras que el tono de GDELT fue más negativo que la media mundial.
summary.fr: Une collision ferroviaire survenue aux heures de pointe à Prague a fait 46 blessés, dont quatre grièvement. Il s'agit d'un incident notable, sans toutefois constituer une crise à victimes multiples. Les autres informations étaient de routine : une nouvelle coalition pour la mairie de Prague a été signée, l'acquisition de systèmes de défense aérienne a été débattue et des événements commémorant l'anniversaire de la Révolution de velours ont eu lieu, tandis que le ton de GDELT était plus négatif que la moyenne mondiale.
summary.de: Ein Zusammenstoß zweier Züge im Berufsverkehr in Prag hat 46 Verletzte gefordert, vier davon schwer. Es handelt sich um einen bemerkenswerten Vorfall, aber nicht um eine Krise mit vielen Opfern. Die übrigen Nachrichten waren Routine: Eine neue Koalition für das Prager Bürgermeisteramt wurde unterzeichnet, die Beschaffung von Luftverteidigungssystemen wurde diskutiert und es fanden Veranstaltungen zum Jahrestag der Samtenen Revolution statt. Der GDELT-Tonwert war negativer als der weltweite Durchschnitt.
summary.pt: Uma colisão de comboios na hora de ponta em Praga deixou 46 feridos, quatro deles em estado grave. É um incidente relevante, mas não uma crise com vítimas em massa. As restantes notícias foram de rotina: foi assinado um novo acordo de coligação para a câmara municipal de Praga, discutiu-se a aquisição de defesa antiaérea e realizaram-se eventos pelo aniversário da Revolução de Veludo, enquanto o tom do GDELT foi mais negativo do que a média mundial.
summary.ja: プラハでラッシュアワーに発生した列車衝突事故で46人が負傷し、そのうち4人が重傷を負った。注目すべき事故ではあるものの、大量死傷者を出す危機ではない。その他のニュースは日常的なもので、プラハ市長の新たな連立協定が署名され、防空装備の調達が議論され、ビロード革命の記念行事が行われた。GDELTのトーンは世界平均よりも否定的だった。

Τα υπόλοιπα νέα ήταν συνηθισμένα: υπογράφηκε νέα συμφωνία συνασπισμού για τον δήμαρχο της Πράγας, συζητήθηκε η προμήθεια αμυντικών συστημάτων αεράμυνας και πραγματοποιήθηκαν εκδηλώσεις για την επέτειο της Βελούδινης Επανάστασης. summary.ar: تهيمن على التغطية نتائج مباريات كرة القدم في التصفيات، وهي غير ذات صلة بالأوضاع الوطنية. الإشارات الجوهرية الوحيدة هي عنوان يصف أزمة سياسية ومقال تفسيري عن الانتخابات، وهما يشيران إلى بعض الضغط المؤسسي. نبرة GDELT إيجابية بشكل طفيف، لذلك تقع الدرجة أقل قليلاً من يوم روتيني.
summary.fa: پوشش خبری عمدتاً را نتایج مسابقات مقدماتی فوتبال تشکیل می‌دهد که ربطی به شرایط ملی ندارد. تنها نشانه‌های معنادار یک تیتر که بحران سیاسی را توصیف می‌کند و یک گزارش تحلیلی درباره انتخابات است که به نوعی فشار نهادی اشاره دارند. لحن GDELT اندکی مثبت است، از این رو امتیاز کمی پایین‌تر از یک روز عادی قرار می‌گیرد.
summary.zh: 报道主要集中在足球预选赛结果上，与国家状况无关。仅有的实质性信号是一条描述政治危机的标题和一篇关于选举的解读文章，表明存在一定的制度压力。GDELT语气略微积极，因此分数略低于普通的一天。
summary.ja: 報道の大半はサッカー予選の結果が占めており、国内の状況とは無関係です。実質的な手がかりは、政治危機を伝える見出しと選挙に関する解説記事のみで、制度面での緊張がある程度うかがえます。GDELTのトーンはわずかに肯定的であるため、スコアは通常の日よりやや低い水準にとどまっています。
summary.ko: 보도의 대부분은 축구 예선 결과가 차지하고 있으며, 이는 국내 상황과 무관합니다. 실질적인 신호는 정치적 위기를 다룬 헤드라인과 선거에 관한 해설 기사뿐이며, 이는 어느 정도 제도적 긴장이 있음을 시사합니다. GDELT 어조는 약간 긍정적이어서 점수는 일상적인 날보다 다소 낮은 수준입니다.
summary.hi: कवरेज में अधिकतर फ़ुटबॉल क्वालिफ़ायर के परिणाम छाए हुए हैं, जिनका राष्ट्रीय स्थिति से कोई संबंध नहीं है। केवल दो सार्थक संकेत हैं: एक राजनीतिक संकट का वर्णन करने वाली सुर्खी और चुनावों पर एक व्याख्यात्मक लेख, जो कुछ संस्थागत तनाव की ओर इशारा करते हैं। GDELT का स्वर हल्का सकारात्मक है, इसलिए स्कोर एक सामान्य दिन से थोड़ा नीचे है।
summary.el: Η κάλυψη κυριαρχείται από αποτελέσματα προκριματικών αγώνων ποδοσφαίρου, τα οποία δεν σχετίζονται με τις εθνικές συνθήκες. Τα μόνα ουσιαστικά σήματα είναι ένας τίτλος που περιγράφει μια πολιτική κρίση και ένα εξηγητικό άρθρο για τις εκλογές, που υποδηλώνουν κάποια θεσμική πίεση. Ο τόνος του GDELT είναι ήπια θετικός, οπότε η βαθμολογία βρίσκεται ελαφρώς κάτω από μια συνηθισμένη ημέρα.

El tono de GDELT es ligeramente positivo, por lo que la puntuación se sitúa algo por debajo de un día rutinario.

summary.en: In the last 24 hours there is no clear crisis in Mauritania. The agenda includes routine administrative activities, talks with an IMF mission, a 16% increase in natural gas exports and a decline in the debt-to-GDP ratio. Although there are minor tensions such as a taxi drivers' strike threat in Nouadhibou and political debates, the overall picture is calm and slightly positive.

en: 16% increase in natural gas exports and a decline in the debt-to-GDP ratio
Talks with an IMF mission and diplomatic contacts (Chad, Russia, UN)
No crisis; routine administrative activities (cleanup campaigns, migration forum)
Minor issues such as a taxi strike threat in Nouadhibou and political debates

summary.en: The day's coverage is largely routine: diplomatic credential ceremonies, IMF and World Bank reform discussions, an EU urban-development agreement, and health-centre and climate initiatives. The main negative item is a drone strike at the Morocco-Mauritania border that killed a gold miner, which is a local incident rather than a national crisis.

en: Routine diplomatic activity: multiple ambassadors presented credentials
IMF mission and World Bank reform matrix discussions on finance and resilience
EU-Nouakchott agreement to redevelop a neighbourhood; uranium project progress

Negative items include a Lagouira border dispute with Morocco, coordinated opposition protests in 15 wilayas, and reports of a jailed deputy and bloggers' case, which together pull the score slightly below neutral.

en: Lagouira border dispute with Morocco and Mauritania's denials
Opposition Tewassoul protests across 15 wilayas
Jailing of anti-slavery deputy reported by foreign outlet

Offsetting concerns include a government denial in a border dispute with Morocco, an opposition protest against a possible third presidential term, and student protests over scholarship irregularities.

en: Budget surplus of US$155M projected for 2027
Government denies claims over Lagouira border area with Morocco
Opposition protest against possible third presidential term

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: infrastructure and electricity-grid deals, mining revenue payments, a CAF stadium accreditation, and a cabinet reshuffle that kept the PM. Negatives are minor, including a student protest, a dust storm, illegal-fishing allegations and a criminal case, and the tone is somewhat more negative than the world average.

Tasiast mine pays $266.1M to state in 2025
CAF accredits Nouakchott Olympic stadium for 2027 AFCON qualifiers

summary.en: The period is routine, with university research expansion, municipal cleaning campaigns, a new bank branch, mining-sector engagement and gas-sector discussions. Negatives are limited to a teachers' union demand, inflation forecasts above 7% from the IMF, fuel smuggling seizures and tensions with Morocco.

en: Six new university labs and eleven research units approved
Government and IMF inflation forecasts diverge sharply
Teachers' union demands ministry intervention over curriculum

summary.en: The period was mostly routine, with a forecast of 5% growth for 2027, a suspended university-union sit-in, and institutional visits to women's prisons. A Morocco-Mauritania dispute over Lagouira fishing waters, with reports of Moroccan navy expulsions of Mauritanian boats, is the main negative and keeps the score only slightly above an ordinary day.

en: Forecast of 5% growth expected in 2027
Lagouira fishing-boat expulsions fuel Morocco-Mauritania sovereignty dispute
Higher education union suspends planned sit-in in Nouakchott

summary.en: The period was mostly routine: presidential travel to a Russia-Africa summit, economic and investment initiatives, and infrastructure work such as the Mauritania-Mali power link. Negatives were limited to student protests with injuries at Nouakchott university, a postponed book fair, and a dispute over a language circular, which keep the score near neutral.

en: Student protests with injuries at Nouakchott university
Power interconnection project with Mali accelerating
Presidential trip to Russia-Africa summit

summary.en: The period looks routine with mild positives: an $80 million solar-plus-storage financing prospect, a 2027 budget projecting higher revenue, a new 5G launch, and active diplomacy with Russia and China. Offsetting concerns include a university transport-fare strike, uncertainty over the Spanish fishing agreement, and local power outages.

2027 budget draft projects higher revenues and growth
Student strike over higher university transport fares

summary.en: The day was mostly routine: a first-of-its-kind medical procedure, development-financing talks and an AfDB project announcement. Mild negatives came from police dispersing a student protest and a debate over a third term and a proposed transition, with tone slightly better than the world average.

en: First brain catheterization procedures performed by Mauritanian medical teams
AfDB financing details for Nouakchott hybrid power station project
Police dispersal of student protest in Nouakchott

Opposition figure condemns violence against party militants

IMF mission reviewing economic reforms and food security

summary.ar: تسير الفترة في معظمها بشكل روتيني: اتفاقيات تعاون مع المغرب وإيطاليا، وعودة الرئيس من قمة، والاستقالة البرلمانية للنائب بيرام داه عبيد. وتقتصر السلبيات على انتهاء اتفاقية الصيد مع الاتحاد الأوروبي، التي أدت إلى طرد الأساطيل الإسبانية، واعتراض قارب مهاجرين، دون أزمة واضحة.
summary.fa: این دوره عمدتاً روال معمول دارد: توافق‌نامه‌های همکاری با مراکش و ایتالیا، بازگشت رئیس‌جمهور از یک اجلاس، و استعفای پارلمانی نماینده مجلس بیرام داه عبید. موارد منفی محدود است به پایان یافتن توافق ماهیگیری با اتحادیه اروپا که به اخراج ناوگان‌های اسپانیایی انجامید، و توقیف یک قایق مهاجران، بدون بحران روشن.
summary.zh: 这一时期大体属于例行事务：与摩洛哥和意大利的合作协议、总统结束峰会后返回国内，以及议员比拉姆·达赫·阿比德辞去议会职务。负面消息仅限于欧盟渔业协定到期，导致西班牙渔船队被驱逐，以及一艘移民船只被拦截，但并未出现明显危机。
summary.ja: この期間は大半が通常の出来事です。モロッコおよびイタリアとの協力合意、大統領のサミットからの帰国、そしてビラム・ダ・アビド国会議員の議員辞職などが報じられました。否定的な出来事は、EU漁業協定の失効によりスペインの漁船団が排除されたことと、移民の船舶が阻止されたことに限られており、明確な危機は見られません。
summary.ko: 이번 기간은 대체로 일상적인 사안들로 이루어졌습니다. 모로코 및 이탈리아와의 협력 협정, 정상회담을 마친 대통령의 귀국, 그리고 비람 다 아비드 국회의원의 의원직 사임 등이 있었습니다. 부정적인 소식은 EU 어업협정 만료로 스페인 어선단이 쫓겨난 사안과 이주민 선박의 차단으로 제한되며, 뚜렷한 위기는 없었습니다.
summary.hi: यह अवधि ज़्यादातर नियमित घटनाओं से भरी रही: मोरक्को और इटली के साथ सहयोग समझौते, शिखर सम्मेलन से राष्ट्रपति की वापसी, और सांसद बिराम दाह अब्दी का संसदीय इस्तीफ़ा। नकारात्मक घटनाएँ केवल यूरोपीय संघ के मत्स्य समझौते की समाप्ति तक सीमित रहीं, जिससे स्पेनिश मछली पकड़ने वाले बेड़े बाहर किए गए, और एक प्रवासी नाव को रोके जाने तक; कोई स्पष्ट संकट नहीं था।
summary.el: Η περίοδος είναι κυρίως ρουτινική: συμφωνίες συνεργασίας με το Μαρόκο και την Ιταλία, η επιστροφή του προέδρου από μια σύνοδο κορυφής και η κοινοβουλευτική παραίτηση του βουλευτή Μπιράμ Νταχ Αμπέιντ. Τα αρνητικά περιορίζονται στη λήξη της αλιευτικής συμφωνίας της ΕΕ, η οποία άφησε τους ισπανικούς στόλους εκτός περιοχής, και στην αναχαίτιση ενός σκάφους μεταναστών, χωρίς σαφή κρίση.
summary.tr: Dönem büyük ölçüde rutin gelişmelerden oluşuyor: Fas ve İtalya ile iş birliği anlaşmaları, cumhurbaşkanının bir zirveden dönüşü ve milletvekili Biram Dah Abeid'in meclisten istifası. Olumsuz gelişmeler, AB balıkçılık anlaşmasının sona ermesiyle İspanyol filolarının dışlanması ve bir göçmen teknesine el konulmasıyla sınırlı; net bir kriz bulunmuyor.
summary.es: El período es en su mayoría rutinario: acuerdos de cooperación con Marruecos e Italia, el regreso del presidente de una cumbre y la renuncia parlamentaria del diputado Biram Dah Abeid. Los aspectos negativos se limitan a la expiración del pacto pesquero con la UE, que ha dejado a flotas españolas expulsadas, y a la interceptación de un bote de migrantes, sin una crisis clara.
summary.fr: La période est pour l'essentiel routinière : accords de coopération avec le Maroc et l'Italie, retour du président d'un sommet et démission parlementaire du député Biram Dah Abeid. Les aspects négatifs se limitent à l'expiration de l'accord de pêche avec l'UE, qui a entraîné l'expulsion des flottes espagnoles, et à l'interception d'une embarcation de migrants, sans crise manifeste.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum verlief überwiegend routinemäßig: Kooperationsabkommen mit Marokko und Italien, die Rückkehr des Präsidenten von einem Gipfeltreffen sowie der Rücktritt des Abgeordneten Biram Dah Abeid aus dem Parlament. Negative Entwicklungen beschränken sich auf das Auslaufen des EU-Fischereiabkommens, das zur Ausweisung spanischer Flotten führte, und das Abfangen eines Migrantenbootes, ohne dass eine klare Krise erkennbar ist.
summary.pt: O período é, em grande parte, rotineiro: acordos de cooperação com Marrocos e Itália, o regresso do presidente de uma cimeira e a renúncia parlamentar do deputado Biram Dah Abeid. Os aspetos negativos limitam-se ao termo do acordo de pesca com a UE, que deixou as frotas espanholas expulsas, e à interceção de um barco de migrantes, sem uma crise clara.

summary.ko: 카보베르데의 현직 대통령 조제 마리아 네베스가 잠정적으로 재선되어 2기 임기를 맡게 되었다. 앙골라와 브라질로부터 축하 메시지를 받았으며, 논조는 긍정적이다. 국내의 주요 부정적 요인은 교도관들이 11월 30일부터 무기한 파업을 하겠다고 경고한 것이다.
summary.hi: केप वर्डे के मौजूदा राष्ट्रपति जोसे मारिया नेवेस को दूसरे कार्यकाल के लिए अनंतिम रूप से फिर से निर्वाचित किया गया है, जिस पर अंगोला और ब्राज़ील की ओर से बधाइयाँ मिली हैं, और स्वर सकारात्मक है। घरेलू स्तर पर मुख्य नकारात्मक बात यह है कि जेल कर्मचारियों ने 30 नवंबर से अनिश्चितकालीन हड़ताल की चेतावनी दी है।
summary.el: Ο εν ενεργεία πρόεδρος του Πράσινου Ακρωτηρίου, José Maria Neves, επανεξελέγη προσωρινά για δεύτερη θητεία, λαμβάνοντας συγχαρητήρια από την Ανγκόλα και τη Βραζιλία, και ο τόνος είναι θετικός. Η κύρια εγχώρια αρνητική εξέλιξη είναι η προειδοποίηση των δεσμοφυλάκων για απεργία αορίστου χρόνου από τις 30 Νοεμβρίου.

summary.en: The Houthis are carrying out missile and similar attacks against Saudi Arabia. Explosions were heard in the capital, one missile was intercepted, and US citizens were urged to follow Civil Defense warnings. Regional tensions are keeping oil prices near a five-month high, while economic investment news and diplomatic initiatives continue. Nevertheless, attacks targeting the capital, the postponement of the Future Investment Initiative, and the execution of two Bangladeshi nationals are significantly lowering the diplomatic tension score.

Brent crude trading near a five-month high amid regional tensions

summary.tr: Riyad'a yönelik Husi füze ve insansız hava aracı saldırıları önlendi; başkentte patlamalar duyuldu ve üç bölgede acil durum uyarıları verildi. Yabancı haber kaynaklarına göre Yemen'de Riyad destekli güçler geri çekilme yaşadı. Yabancı hukuk büroları kuralları, yenilenebilir enerji hattı ve 110 milyon dolarlık proje anlaşmaları gibi rutin ekonomik ve reform haberleri bu tabloyu kısmen dengeledi; borsa endeksi düşüşle kapandı.
summary.es: Se interceptaron misiles y drones de los hutíes dirigidos contra Riad; se oyeron explosiones en la capital y se emitieron alertas de emergencia en tres regiones, y medios extranjeros informan de un revés para las fuerzas proriyadíes en Yemen. Noticias económicas y de reformas rutinarias (normas para bufetes extranjeros, cartera de energías renovables, acuerdos de proyectos por 110 millones de dólares) compensan en parte esto, y el índice bursátil cerró a la baja.
summary.fr: Des missiles et drones houthis visant Riyad ont été interceptés, des explosions ont été entendues dans la capitale et des alertes d'urgence ont été émises dans trois régions ; des médias étrangers signalent un revers pour les forces pro-Riyad au Yémen. Des nouvelles économiques et de réformes courantes (règles pour les cabinets d'avocats étrangers, portefeuille d'énergies renouvelables, accords de projets de 110 millions de dollars) atténuent en partie ce tableau, et l'indice boursier a clôturé en baisse.
summary.de: Gegen Riad gerichtete Raketen und Drohnen der Huthi wurden abgefangen, in der Hauptstadt waren Explosionen zu hören, und in drei Regionen wurden Notfallwarnungen ausgegeben; ausländische Medien berichten von einem Rückschlag für die Riad-treuen Kräfte im Jemen. Routinemäßige Wirtschafts- und Reformmeldungen (Regeln für ausländische Anwaltskanzleien, Pipeline erneuerbarer Energien, Projektvereinbarungen über 110 Mio. $) gleichen dies teilweise aus, und der Aktienindex schloss niedriger.
summary.pt: Mísseis e drones dos houthis dirigidos a Riade foram interceptados, ouviram-se explosões na capital e foram emitidos alertas de emergência em três regiões; meios de comunicação estrangeiros relatam um revés para as forças pró-Riade no Iémen. Notícias económicas e de reformas de rotina (regras para escritórios de advocacia estrangeiros, carteira de energias renováveis, acordos de projetos de 110 milhões de dólares) compensam em parte, e o índice bolsista fechou em baixa.
summary.it: Missili e droni Houthi diretti verso Riad sono stati intercettati; esplosioni sono state udite nella capitale e sono stati diramati allarmi di emergenza in tre regioni, mentre media stranieri riferiscono di un arretramento delle forze filo-saudite nello Yemen. Notizie economiche e di riforma di routine (norme sugli studi legali stranieri, pipeline di progetti rinnovabili, accordi per progetti da $110 milioni) attenuano in parte questo quadro, e l'indice azionario ha chiuso in calo.
summary.ru: Ракеты и беспилотники хуситов, направленные на Эр-Рияд, были перехвачены; в столице слышны взрывы, в трёх регионах объявлены экстренные оповещения, а зарубежные издания сообщают о неудаче проэрсаудовских сил в Йемене. Рутинные экономические новости и новости о реформах (правила для иностранных юридических фирм, портфель проектов ВИЭ, сделки по проектам на $110 млн) частично уравновешивают это, а фондовый индекс закрылся ниже.
summary.ar: اعتُرضت صواريخ وطائرات مسيّرة أطلقها الحوثيون باتجاه الرياض، وسُمعت انفجارات في العاصمة وصدرت تنبيهات طارئة في ثلاث مناطق، بينما تفيد وسائل إعلام أجنبية بتراجع القوات الموالية للرياض في اليمن. وتخفف أخبار اقتصادية وإصلاحية اعتيادية (قواعد تخص مكاتب المحاماة الأجنبية، ومشاريع الطاقة المتجددة، وصفقات مشاريع بقيمة 110 ملايين دولار) من هذه الصورة جزئياً، وأُغلق مؤشر الأسهم على انخفاض.
summary.fa: موشک‌ها و پهپادهای حوثی که به سمت ریاض هدف‌گیری شده بودند رهگیری شدند، در پایتخت صدای انفجار شنیده شد و در سه منطقه هشدار اضطراری صادر شد، و رسانه‌های خارجی از عقب‌نشینی نیروهای طرفدار ریاض در یمن خبر می‌دهند. اخبار اقتصادی و اصلاحات معمول (قوانین مربوط به دفاتر حقوقی خارجی، خط لوله پروژه‌های انرژی تجدیدپذیر، توافق‌های پروژه‌ای ۱۱۰ میلیون دلاری) تا حدی این وضعیت را خنثی می‌کند و شاخص بورس با افت بسته شد.
summary.zh: 针对利雅得的胡塞武装导弹和无人机被拦截，首都传出爆炸声，三个地区发布紧急警报，外国媒体报道亲利雅得力量在也门遭遇挫折。例行的经济和改革新闻（外国律师事务所规则、可再生能源项目管线、1.1亿美元项目交易）部分抵消了这一影响，股指收跌。
summary.ja: リヤドに向けて発射されたフーシ派のミサイルとドローンは迎撃された。首都では爆発音が聞こえ、3つの地域で緊急警報が出された。また、外国メディアは、イエメンにおけるサウジ寄りの勢力の後退を報じている。外国法律事務所に関する規則、再生可能エネルギーの案件パイプライン、1億1000万ドル規模のプロジェクト契約といった日常的な経済・改革関連のニュースが、これを部分的に相殺しており、株価指数は下落して取引を終えた。
summary.ko: 리야드를 겨냥한 후티 반군의 미사일과 드론은 요격되었으며, 수도에서는 폭발음이 들리고 세 개 지역에 긴급 경보가 발령되었다. 외신들은 예멘에서 리야드 지지 세력이 후퇴했다고 보도하고 있다. 외국 법률사무소 규정, 재생에너지 프로젝트 파이프라인, 1억 1,000만 달러 규모의 프로젝트 계약 등 일상적인 경제 및 개혁 관련 소식이 이를 일부 상쇄했으며, 주가지수는 하락 마감했다.
summary.hi: रियाद को निशाना बनाकर दागी गईं हूती मिसाइलें और ड्रोन रोक लिए गए, राजधानी में धमाकों की आवाज़ सुनी गई और तीन क्षेत्रों में आपातकालीन चेतावनियाँ जारी की गईं। विदेशी समाचार स्रोतों के अनुसार यमन में रियाद-समर्थक बलों को पीछे हटना पड़ा है। विदेशी विधि फर्मों से जुड़े नियम, नवीकरणीय ऊर्जा परियोजनाओं की पाइपलाइन और 110 मिलियन डॉलर की परियोजना सौदों जैसी नियमित आर्थिक और सुधार संबंधी खबरों ने इसके प्रभाव को कुछ हद तक संतुलित किया, और शेयर सूचकांक गिरावट के साथ बंद हुआ।
summary.el: Πυραύλοι και drones των Χούθι που κατευθύνονταν προς το Ριάντ αναχαιτίστηκαν, ακούστηκαν εκρήξεις στην πρωτεύουσα και εκδόθηκαν έκτακτες ειδοποιήσεις σε τρεις περιοχές, ενώ ξένα μέσα ενημέρωσης αναφέρουν οπισθοδρόμηση των δυνάμεων που υποστηρίζουν το Ριάντ στην Υεμένη. Τα συνήθη οικονομικά και μεταρρυθμιστικά νέα (κανόνες για ξένα δικηγορικά γραφεία, αγωγός έργων ανανεώσιμων πηγών και συμφωνίες έργων ύψους 110 εκατ. δολαρίων) αντισταθμίζουν εν μέρει την εξέλιξη, και ο δείκτης του χρηματιστηρίου έκλεισε με πτώση.

summary.ru: Период явно положителен с точки зрения экономики: МВФ одобрил финансирование в размере 78 миллионов долларов по итогам обзора, а несколько инвестиционных, энергетических и гуманитарных инициатив указывают на внешнее участие. В противовес этому МВФ предупредил, что экономические успехи находятся под давлением, и появились сообщения о материнской смертности и проблемах с верховенством права.
summary.ar: تتسم الفترة بإيجابية واضحة على الصعيد الاقتصادي، إذ وافق صندوق النقد الدولي على مراجعة تمويل بقيمة 78 مليون دولار، وتشير عدة مبادرات في مجالات الاستثمار والطاقة والتعاون إلى مشاركة خارجية. وفي المقابل، حذّر الصندوق من أن المكاسب الاقتصادية تتعرض لضغوط، وهناك تقارير عن وفيات الأمهات ومخاوف تتعلق بسيادة القانون.
summary.fa: این دوره از نظر اقتصادی به‌روشنی مثبت است: صندوق بین‌المللی پول بازبینی تأمین مالی به ارزش ۷۸ میلیون دلار را تصویب کرد و چند اقدام در زمینه سرمایه‌گذاری، انرژی و همکاری نشان‌دهنده مشارکت خارجی است. در مقابل، صندوق هشدار داد که دستاوردهای اقتصادی تحت فشار هستند و گزارش‌هایی درباره مرگ‌ومیر مادران و نگرانی‌ها درباره حاکمیت قانون منتشر شده است.
summary.zh: 这一时期经济方面明显向好：国际货币基金组织批准了7800万美元的融资审查，多项投资、能源和合作事项表明外部参与增多。与此相对，国际货币基金组织警告经济成果面临压力，并有关于孕产妇死亡率和法治问题的报道。
summary.ja: この期間は経済面で明確に前向きです。IMFが7,800万ドルの融資を承認する見通しを示したほか、投資、エネルギー、協力に関する複数の案件が、対外的な関与の広がりを示しています。一方で、IMFは経済成長の成果が圧力にさらされていると警告しており、妊産婦死亡率や法の支配に関する報道もあります。
summary.ko: 이번 기간은 경제 측면에서 분명히 긍정적입니다. IMF가 7,800만 달러 규모의 자금 지원 검토를 승인했으며, 여러 투자, 에너지 및 협력 사안은 대외 협력이 확대되고 있음을 보여줍니다. 반면 IMF는 경제적 성과가 압박을 받고 있다고 경고했으며, 산모 사망률과 법치 관련 우려도 보도되었습니다.
summary.hi: यह अवधि अर्थव्यवस्था के संदर्भ में स्पष्ट रूप से सकारात्मक रही है: आईएमएफ ने 7.8 करोड़ डॉलर की फंडिंग समीक्षा को मंज़ूरी दी, और कई निवेश, ऊर्जा और सहयोग संबंधी घटनाएँ बाहरी जुड़ाव की ओर इशारा करती हैं। इसके विपरीत, आईएमएफ ने चेतावनी दी कि आर्थिक लाभ दबाव में हैं, और मातृ मृत्यु दर तथा कानून के शासन से जुड़ी चिंताओं की रिपोर्टें भी हैं।
summary.el: Η περίοδος είναι σαφώς θετική για την οικονομία: το ΔΝΤ ενέκρινε αναθεώρηση χρηματοδότησης ύψους 78 εκατομμυρίων δολαρίων, και αρκετές επενδυτικές, ενεργειακές και συνεργατικές εξελίξεις δείχνουν εξωτερική εμπλοκή. Αντίθετα, το ΔΝΤ προειδοποίησε ότι τα οικονομικά κέρδη βρίσκονται υπό πίεση, ενώ υπάρχουν αναφορές για τη μητρική θνησιμότητα και ανησυχίες για το κράτος δικαίου.
summary.tr: Dönem ekonomi açısından açıkça olumlu seyrediyor: IMF 78 milyon dolarlık finansman incelemesini onayladı ve birkaç yatırım, enerji ve iş birliği gelişmesi dış ilgiye işaret ediyor. Buna karşılık IMF, ekonomik kazanımların baskı altında olduğu konusunda uyardı; ayrıca anne ölümleri ve hukukun üstünlüğü kaygılarına ilişkin haberler var.
summary.es: El período es claramente positivo para la economía: el FMI aprobó la revisión de un financiamiento de 78 millones de dólares, y varios avances en inversión, energía y cooperación apuntan a una mayor participación exterior. En sentido contrario, el FMI advirtió que las ganancias económicas están bajo presión, y hay informes sobre mortalidad materna y preocupaciones sobre el Estado de derecho.
summary.fr: La période est nettement positive sur le plan économique : le FMI a approuvé la revue d'un financement de 78 millions de dollars, et plusieurs projets d'investissement, d'énergie et de coopération témoignent d'un engagement extérieur. En contrepartie, le FMI a averti que les gains économiques sont sous pression, et des informations font état de mortalité maternelle et de préoccupations relatives à l'État de droit.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum ist wirtschaftlich klar positiv: Der IWF billigte die Überprüfung einer Finanzierung über 78 Millionen US-Dollar, und mehrere Investitions-, Energie- und Kooperationsvorhaben deuten auf auswärtiges Engagement hin. Dem stehen die Warnung des IWF, dass die wirtschaftlichen Fortschritte unter Druck stehen, sowie Berichte über Müttersterblichkeit und Bedenken hinsichtlich der Rechtsstaatlichkeit gegenüber.
summary.pt: O período é claramente positivo para a economia: o FMI aprovou a revisão de um financiamento de 78 milhões de dólares, e vários projetos de investimento, energia e cooperação indicam engajamento externo. Em contrapartida, o FMI alertou que os ganhos econômicos estão sob pressão, e há relatos sobre mortalidade materna e preocupações com o Estado de direito.

summary.en: The campaign period before the 5 December election in Gambia continues. There is political tension (mutual accusations regarding the IEC), but Barrow calls for a peaceful campaign, and the EU will send an observation mission. The UN's praise for transitional justice and migration cooperation are positive; the death of 12 people in the boat accident off Jinack is negative. The overall picture is consistent with an ordinary period.

en: Election campaign and political tension over the IEC, but a call for a peaceful campaign
UN Special Rapporteur's praise for transitional justice
Boat accident off Jinack, 12 dead
According to Frontex, a decline in departures to Europe through migration cooperation
EU sending an election observation mission

summary.en: The period mixes positive developments, chiefly the reparations funds from the sale of ex-ruler Jammeh's US property for victims and pledges of a peaceful December election, with recurring irregular-migration incidents and a political accusation of incitement to violence. GDELT tone is more negative than the world average, but the domestic headlines lean toward routine institutional activity.

en: Jammeh asset sale funds victim reparations ($2.75M)
Officials pledge peaceful, transparent December 5 election
Repeated migrant boat incidents and interceptions off the coast

summary.en: The period is mostly routine, with a positive reparations development: $2.5M from Jammeh's seized US mansion will compensate his victims. Political tension is elevated after the president labelled a candlelight march to State House 'treasonable' ahead of the election, and GDELT tone is somewhat more negative than the world average.

en: $2.5M Jammeh mansion proceeds to compensate victims
President calls candlelight march to State House 'treasonable'
171 migrants rescued after pirogue capsized off Gandiol

summary.en: The period was mostly routine, with several constructive developments: reparations of about $2.57 million to victims of the Jammeh era, a first-ever national communication policy in the works, and a UK-Gambia health research partnership. Migrant interceptions and tribalism concerns were the main negatives, and foreign tone was mildly positive.

en: $2.57M from Jammeh-linked property reversed to victims
Gambia moves to craft first-ever national communication policy
UK-Gambia health research partnership celebrated

summary.en: The period is dominated by routine pre-election activity, including opposition manifestos, calls for tolerance and civil-society training, plus a positive institutional step in transferring recovered Jammeh assets to victims. Offsetting this, migrant boat departures from Gambia led to more than 150 people reported missing and a sharp rise in arrivals in the Canary Islands.

en: Jammeh seized assets transferred to Gambia for victim compensation
Pre-election calls for tolerance and opposition policy platforms
Over 150 migrants reported missing after Gambia departure

summary.en: The relevant coverage is thin and routine: a minor police-vehicle ramming case in Bathurst (which may be Australian) and migrant interceptions reported by Senegalese media. No clear crisis or major institutional development appears, and the negative GDELT tone is only a secondary signal.

en: Three teens charged after police vehicle rammed in Bathurst
Migrant interceptions in Gambian waters reported by Senegalese media

summary.en: Gambian news in this period is mixed but leans positive, led by reparations for Jammeh-era victims funded by $2.5 million in recovered assets and new diplomatic ties with Eritrea. A report of renewed persecution of gay people and GDELT's negative tone (-3.58, versus a world average of -0.71) offset some of that.

en: $2.5M Jammeh asset recovery funds reparations for victims
Eritrea and Gambia establish diplomatic relations
Reported reopening of anti-gay persecution weighs negatively

summary.en: Gambia's day mixed routine governance with a resolved student protest: the government restored services at UTG after protests, and several road projects and a $2.5 million compensation payout for Jammeh victims were announced. Foreign coverage of the protests and a mildly negative news tone keep the score only modestly above an ordinary day.

en: Government restored catering, buses, water and internet after UTG student protests
Start of 20.5km Choya-Dankunku Road and opening of 91km road network
$2.5M US-returned funds to compensate Jammeh victims

summary.en: The period was largely routine, with institutional and development news such as an ILO convention ratification roadmap, digital ID adoption, and hosting a geological assembly. Student protests over campus conditions and fuel subsidy spending were the main negatives, and GDELT tone (+0.13) sits above the world average.

en: Roadmap to ratify ILO Domestic Workers Convention
Student protests over poor campus conditions at UTG
Adoption of Ghana's digital identity technology

summary.en: The period was dominated by routine but constructive news: corporate and partner pledges, a US$46m Ghanaian waste-management deal, health-sector investment and a maternal-health initiative. Negatives were limited to irregular migration interceptions, a student protest and a rights defender's jailing, and no crisis emerged.

en: US$46m waste management deal signed with Ghana's Jospong Group
Presidential initiative to reduce maternal deaths launched
WAHO donates sequencing device and lab investment to strengthen services

summary.en: The period is largely routine: development financing (solar, student loans, fertilizer and clean-cooking plans), a loan repayment and health cooperation with ECOMIG. A University of The Gambia student protest over campus services and migrant interceptions are the main negatives, and the GDELT tone is mildly positive.

en: Large solar energy financing announced (99.5 billion FCFA)
Student loan scheme to expand access to higher education
Government begins repaying the D563M GTSC bus loan

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: an IMF deal on the ECF and Resilience Facility reviews and a ten-year revenue-security contract are modest positives. These are offset by migrant boat deaths, a survey showing youth pessimism, debt taking a third of the budget, and a stalled constitution.

en: IMF agreement on ECF and Resilience Facility reviews
InTouch ten-year contract to secure state revenue
Migrant boat tragedies with multiple deaths reported

summary.en: The period is dominated by migration stories: boats leaving Gambia for the Canary Islands, rescues, deaths at sea and arrests on beaches. Add a survey showing low youth confidence in the government's economic performance and a sharp exchange between a presidential hopeful's party and the government, and the picture is somewhat worse than a routine day, though not a crisis.

en: Migrant boats from Gambia rescued near Canaries, with several deaths reported
Low youth confidence in government economic performance survey
Arrests of would-be migrants on Gambian beaches and at Tanji

summary.en: Only a few headlines concern The Gambia itself, and they are mixed: a US$169M solar plant deal was signed before a vote, and Gambian produce was showcased at a trade fair, while irregular migration from Gambia continued. GDELT tone is negative, but the relevant news flow looks like an ordinary period.

en: US$169M solar plant deal signed before vote
Gambian chili producers promoted at CIIE trade fair
307 migrants from Gambia rescued near El Hierro

summary.en: A pre-election period with mixed signals: the government ordered the removal of opposition mayors and probes of local and opposition figures, which weighs on institutions. Offsetting this, the IMF unlocked $28m as growth continued, reports pointed to easing tension between government and press, and a waste-management deal was signed.

en: Government orders removal of opposition mayors, raising institutional pressure
IMF unlocks $28m as economy grows
Signs of easing tension between government and press

summary.en: The period is largely routine: voter registration for the December presidential election, development-bank and ECOWAS project news, and a health-lab meeting. Negatives include a dispute over a central bank order affecting 57 Nigerian bank workers and calls for peaceful campaigning, with GDELT tone moderately negative.

en: IEC registers 1.14 million voters ahead of December election
Central bank order to replace 57 Nigerian bank workers draws protest
AfDB and ECOWAS energy and project delivery updates

summary.en: Gambia's news flow is mostly routine: government development projects, an ECOWAS electricity project, and preparations for the December presidential election with 1.1 million registered voters. Offsetting this are a press-freedom complaint over harassment of journalists and a partisan dispute over a report, while anti-corruption charges against an ex-agency CEO point to accountability.

en: Electoral process advancing toward December vote with 1.1 million voters
Anti-corruption action: ex-BAC CEO suspended and charged
TUC-Africa condemns harassment of journalists in Gambia

summary.en: The period reads as routine pre-election activity in Gambia: candidate nominations for the 5 December poll, a rise in winter tourist arrivals, and a court sentence in a child abuse case. GDELT tone (-0.20) is milder than the world average, but a possible move to re-allow FGM and fisheries and audit disputes keep it close to an ordinary day.

en: Winter tourism arrivals strong at Banjul Airport
Election nominations filed ahead of 5 December poll
Court sentences Quranic teacher to 10 years for child abuse

summary.en: The period looks routine: pre-election preparations for the December polls, a digital skills programme, and a new GDP revenue strategy. Negatives include a youth survey showing pessimism about the country's direction, a council dispute over the Mayor's removal, and migrant interceptions, but none amount to a clear crisis.

en: EU deploys long-term observers ahead of December polls
Government launches digital skills programme for 1,280 youths
Youth survey finds three-fourths see country moving wrong direction

summary.en: The period looks ordinary: a boat fire off Gambia ended with 101 migrants rescued, and local fashion entrepreneurs gained international exposure. GDELT tone is mildly negative but less so than the global average, so the score sits slightly above a typical day.

en: 101 migrants rescued after pirogue caught fire at sea
Gambian fashion entrepreneurs gaining international market access at CANEX
Routine election-system explainer; no political crisis reported

summary.en: The period is mostly routine, with a government revenue target and a tourism promotion alongside a boat fire where 101 migrants were rescued. Three migrant bodies found on a beach are a real tragedy, and GDELT tone is negative, so the score sits slightly below neutral.

en: Three migrant bodies found on Tujereng beach
101 migrants rescued after boat fire off Gambia
Government targets 3.2% of GDP in new revenue

summary.en: The period reads as a routine pre-election news cycle: candidate nominations, development and agriculture programmes, and migrant interceptions, with no clear crisis. GDELT tone is quite negative, but it is only a secondary signal, so the score stays near the ordinary baseline.

en: Presidential nominations and large rallies ahead of the election
Government infrastructure and agricultural mechanisation announcements
Migrant boat rescue and interceptions off the coast

summary.en: The period was routine: the electoral process advanced with 12 presidential nomination papers filed and the IEC confirming Bensouda meets requirements, alongside aid distribution, a tourism blueprint and a China-Gambia diplomatic milestone. Concerns include a delayed legal challenge over the Chief Justice's appointment and disputes over a government White Paper, so the score sits modestly above an ordinary day.

en: IEC confirms 12 presidential nomination papers filed for December election
Tourism blueprint and aid distribution signal routine development activity
Delay in suit challenging Chief Justice's appointment raises institutional concern

summary.en: The period is a routine pre-election run-up to the December 5 presidential poll, with ECOWAS peace-training and voter-registration news, a constitutional debate, and an aid delivery for a scabies outbreak. No acute crisis appears in the headlines, and GDELT tone is mildly positive.

en: ECOWAS peace-actor training ahead of the December presidential election
Over 1.1 million eligible voters registered for the December poll
Japan and UNICEF health supplies for scabies outbreak

summary.en: The Gambia is in a routine pre-election period: the electoral commission validated five presidential candidates, including the country's first woman candidate, ahead of the 5 December vote. The EFF's withdrawal and its doubts about IEC credibility add some tension, but there is no crackdown or crisis, and GDELT tone is mildly positive.

en: First woman validated as presidential candidate for December 5 poll
EFF withdraws from race, questioning IEC's ability to ensure credible elections
Five candidates cleared by IEC; electoral process proceeding on schedule

summary.en: The period shows an orderly run-up to Gambia's presidential election: the electoral commission validated five candidates, ECOWAS observers were briefed, and rights monitors trained electoral actors. Migrant interceptions and a debate on transitional justice are routine, and the GDELT tone is mildly positive, so the score sits modestly above a typical day.

en: Electoral commission validates five presidential candidates, including the incumbent
ECOWAS observers and human rights monitors prepare for the presidential polls
Debate on inclusive transitional justice voices, including Jammeh and victims

summary.en: Gambia-specific coverage is sparse: the main items are a routine presidential race with nine candidates, a Chinese embassy reception and a Gambian community solidarity event. Most migration headlines concern Spain's Canary Islands route and Senegalese shores, so they say little about Gambia itself, and the score stays near an ordinary day.

en: Nine candidates registered for presidential election, incumbent seeking new mandate
Routine diplomatic reception at Chinese Embassy in Banjul
Migration headlines mostly about Canary route, not Gambia

summary.en: Coverage of The Gambia in this period is thin and mostly routine: nine presidential candidates have been put forward for the upcoming election, and there are migrant interceptions and a fraud arrest near the border. Nothing signals a crisis, and the somewhat negative news tone is not enough to lower the score.

en: Nine presidential candidates registered for the upcoming election, including the incumbent seeking a third term
215 migrants intercepted in Gambian waters, mostly Senegalese nationals
Routine fraud arrest at the Gambian border; no state-level impact

summary.en: Gambia's presidential campaign opened with candidates signing a peace pact, and UNOWAS and ECOWAS activity reinforced the focus on peaceful, institutional process. Tension remains over Barrow's third-term eligibility and a CoPG warning about prolonged rule, plus unpaid groundnut farmers, but the period leans toward clearly positive institutional developments.

en: Presidential candidates sign peace pact before December 5 vote
UNOWAS reaffirms commitment to peaceful elections
IEC clears nine candidates; third-term controversy persists

summary.en: Pre-election news is mostly routine, with presidential candidates signing a peace pact and ECOWAS and civic groups promoting peaceful, credible December polls. Negatives include youth unemployment at 41%, criticism of the incumbent's third-term bid, and a more negative-than-average GDELT tone, which keep the score only moderately above normal.
summary.tr: Seçim öncesi haberlerin çoğu rutin nitelikte; cumhurbaşkanlığı adayları bir barış paktı imzaladı, ECOWAS ve sivil toplum grupları ise Aralık seçimlerinin barışçıl ve güvenilir olması için çağrıda bulunuyor. Olumsuz unsurlar arasında yüzde 41 oranındaki genç işsizliği, mevcut lider Ulus'un üçüncü dönem adaylığına yönelik eleştiriler ve GDELT'e göre ortalamadan daha olumsuz bir ton yer alıyor; bu nedenle puan normal düzeyin yalnızca orta derecede üzerinde kalıyor.
summary.es: Las noticias previas a las elecciones son en su mayoría rutinarias: los candidatos presidenciales firmaron un pacto de paz y la CEDEAO y grupos cívicos promueven unos comicios de diciembre pacíficos y creíbles. Entre los aspectos negativos figuran el desempleo juvenil del 41 %, las críticas a la aspiración del actual mandatario a un tercer mandato y un tono en GDELT más negativo que la media, lo que mantiene la puntuación solo moderadamente por encima de lo normal.
summary.fr: Les actualités précédant le scrutin sont pour la plupart de routine : les candidats à la présidentielle ont signé un pacte de paix, et la CEDEAO ainsi que des groupes citoyens appellent à des élections de décembre pacifiques et crédibles. Les aspects négatifs incluent un chômage des jeunes de 41 %, les critiques visant la candidature de l'actuel dirigeant à un troisième mandat et un ton plus négatif que la moyenne selon GDELT, ce qui ne place le score que modérément au-dessus de la normale.
summary.de: Die Nachrichten vor der Wahl sind größtenteils routinemäßig: Die Präsidentschaftskandidaten haben einen Friedenspakt unterzeichnet, und die ECOWAS sowie zivilgesellschaftliche Gruppen werben für friedliche und glaubwürdige Wahlen im Dezember. Negativ schlagen die Jugendarbeitslosigkeit von 41 %, die Kritik an der Kandidatur des amtierenden Präsidenten für eine dritte Amtszeit und ein im Vergleich zum Durchschnitt negativeres Tonbild in GDELT zu Buche, weshalb der Wert nur mäßig über dem Normalniveau liegt.
summary.pt: As notícias anteriores às eleições são em grande parte rotineiras: os candidatos presidenciais assinaram um pacto de paz, e a CEDEAO e grupos cívicos promovem eleições de dezembro pacíficas e credíveis. Os aspetos negativos incluem o desemprego juvenil de 41%, as críticas à candidatura do atual presidente a um terceiro mandato e um tom mais negativo do que a média no GDELT, o que mantém a pontuação apenas moderadamente acima do normal.
summary.ja: 選挙前のニュースは大部分が日常的なもので、大統領候補者が平和協定に署名し、ECOWASと市民団体が12月の平和的で信頼性の高い選挙を推進している。マイナス要素として、若年失業率41%、現職の三選出馬への批判、平均より否定的なGDELTのトーンがあり、スコアは通常より中程度に高い水準にとどまっている。
summary.ko: 선거 전 뉴스는 대부분 일상적인 내용으로, 대통령 후보들이 평화협정에 서명했고 ECOWAS와 시민단체들은 12월 선거가 평화롭고 신뢰할 수 있게 치러지도록 독려하고 있다. 부정적 요인으로는 41%의 청년 실업률, 현직 대통령의 3선 도전에 대한 비판, 그리고 평균보다 부정적인 GDELT 논조가 있어 점수는 평소보다 중간 정도로만 높은 수준을 유지하고 있다.
summary.hi: चुनाव-पूर्व समाचार ज़्यादातर सामान्य हैं, जिनमें राष्ट्रपति पद के उम्मीदवारों ने शांति समझौते पर हस्ताक्षर किए हैं और ECOWAS तथा नागरिक समूह दिसंबर में शांतिपूर्ण और विश्वसनीय चुनावों को बढ़ावा दे रहे हैं। नकारात्मक पहलुओं में 41% युवा बेरोज़गारी, वर्तमान शासक के तीसरे कार्यकाल की दावेदारी की आलोचना, और औसत से अधिक नकारात्मक GDELT लहजा शामिल हैं, जिनके कारण स्कोर सामान्य से केवल मध्यम रूप से ऊपर बना हुआ है।
summary.el: Οι ειδήσεις πριν από τις εκλογές είναι στο μεγαλύτερο μέρος τους συνηθισμένες, με τους υποψήφιους για την προεδρία να υπογράφουν σύμφωνο ειρήνης και την ECOWAS και πολιτικές οργανώσεις να προωθούν ειρηνικές, αξιόπιστες εκλογές τον Δεκέμβριο. Τα αρνητικά στοιχεία περιλαμβάνουν ανεργία νέων 41%, κριτική για την υποψηφιότητα του εν ενεργεία για τρίτη θητεία και τόνο GDELT πιο αρνητικό από τον μέσο όρο, που κρατούν τη βαθμολογία μόνο μετρίως πάνω από το κανονικό.
summary.it: Le notizie precedenti alle elezioni sono per lo più di routine: i candidati alla presidenza hanno firmato un patto di pace, mentre ECOWAS e gruppi civici promuovono elezioni di dicembre pacifiche e credibili. Tra gli elementi negativi figurano la disoccupazione giovanile al 41%, le critiche alla candidatura del presidente uscente per un terzo mandato e un tono GDELT più negativo della media, che mantengono il punteggio solo moderatamente sopra la norma.
summary.ru: Новости перед выборами в основном рутинные: кандидаты в президенты подписали мирный пакт, а ECOWAS и гражданские организации продвигают мирные и заслуживающие доверия декабрьские выборы. Негативные факторы включают безработицу среди молодежи на уровне 41%, критику заявки действующего президента на третий срок и более негативный, чем в среднем, тон GDELT, из-за чего показатель лишь умеренно выше нормы.
summary.ar: تتسم الأخبار السابقة للانتخابات في معظمها بالطابع الروتيني، إذ وقّع المرشحون للرئاسة ميثاق سلام، while ECOWAS والمجموعات المدنية تروّج لانتخابات ديسمبر سلمية وموثوقة. وتشمل السلبيات بطالة الشباب البالغة 41%، والانتقادات الموجهة لترشح الرئيس الحالي لولاية ثالثة، ونبرة GDELT الأكثر سلبية من المعدل المعتاد، مما يُبقي النتيجة أعلى من المستوى الطبيعي بدرجة معتدلة فقط.
summary.fa: اخبار پیش از انتخابات عمدتاً روتین است؛ نامزدهای ریاست جمهوری پیمان صلح امضا کرده‌اند و ECOWAS و گروه‌های مدنی از برگزاری انتخابات مسالمت‌آمیز و معتبر در دسامبر حمایت می‌کنند. موارد منفی شامل بیکاری جوانان به میزان 41%، انتقاد از نامزدی رئیس‌جمهور فعلی برای سومین دوره، و لحن منفی‌تر از میانگین GDELT است که امتیاز را تنها به‌طور متوسط بالاتر از حد معمول نگه می‌دارد.
